# Navratri photobooth backgrounds

Created with the built-in image-generation tool, using the existing painted selfie courtyard as the visual reference. `photobooth.webp` is the wide scene; `photobooth-mobile.webp` is a recomposed portrait version that retains the camera, circular light frame and backdrop. Both are artistic impressions of a photo zone, not documentary pictures of the venue.

## Wide edit prompt

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied painted venue courtyard background into a clearly recognizable premium Navratri PHOTOBOOTH area, retaining the same warm hand-painted storybook architectural style and lantern-lit nighttime mood. Replace the distant open floral arch and skyline in the centre with a large freestanding photography backdrop: deep emerald and burgundy vertical textile panels with fine gold embroidered diamond mirrors, dense orange marigold and ivory jasmine garlands, rich flower clusters, symmetrical brass lamps, a generous illuminated round ornamental frame around the photo posing area. Have a charming camera on a slender tripod with a soft circular photo light just to the left of the backdrop, visibly a photography setup rather than a stage. Elegant, festive, artistic, highly detailed, no people because the existing two animated characters will stand in front. Keep the centre lower half as open stone flooring for character placement. No text, no logos, no lettering or fake brands. Booth and its details should be clear in central cropping. Wide landscape composition, full-bleed artwork, opaque background. Match the emerald/burgundy/marigold photo print already used in the story.

## Portrait edit prompt

Adapt the same scene to a tall 9:16 phone composition. Recompose rather than crop. Keep the complete circular frame, camera and ring light visible; reserve the dark upper quarter for title/dialogue, centre for the booth and lower stone floor for the characters. Preserve the painted style, emerald/burgundy embroidery, marigolds, jasmine, brass lamps and warm lighting. No people, text or logos.
